method: New repository records derived from parent-reviewed facts and supported read-only Library text reads. Full original claims, reviewed source records and independent review reports remain in the audit Library files; no byte-for-byte audit materialisation was installed.
retention: All 74 future/recurring candidates retained offline; only 28 independent-review-approved future candidates enter public assets.
precisionNotes: Month endpoints bound the published month/window; they are not exact opening dates.
Qualitative official windows are retained verbatim without invented dates.
A provider's check-back month stays recurring/unconfirmed.
Source-stated hours with unknown time zone remain text; no UTC timestamp is fabricated.
EOI/register/pool/enquiry acceptance is distinct from a vacancy or guaranteed admission.
International conditional access requires the published work/study/location conditions; sponsorship and Australia-based remote work are not presumed.
Original registry IDs and related university/unit IDs are preserved; programme records are not duplicated.
